description: Pinned per-(grammar, seed) duality-break signature sets for the plain-config duality-hunt gate. This lane is the HONEST plain-configuration duality coverage mandated by the STIMULI-SIGNOFF.13.1 design §6 cert-spf adjudication: the certificate-coverage sample_parse_failures=0 claim is config-scoped (its steered, budgeted pass avoids rare forms), so this gate re-earns the duality picture under the hunter's plain configuration. Class identity is the hunter's digit-normalized rejection signature; occurrences and reproducers are deliberately NOT pinned (class-level granularity). A signature observed but not pinned = a NOVEL break class: the gate fails and the class must be routed to a task-tree leaf (the be-alert doctrine). A pinned signature no longer observed = a STALE contract: the closing slice re-baselines this file same-commit, recording closure progress (the cert-baseline discipline).
honest_bounds: The gate sees only generator-emitted-but-parser-REJECTED samples (duality breaks). Accepts-invalid divergences where generator AND parser agree (the REGEX-PCRE2-FIDELITY .3.19/.3.22 classes) are invisible to it by construction — only oracle-differential coverage can see those. Pinned sets are budget- and distribution-scoped: a legitimate grammar/generator change re-baselines them same-slice.
